question: Of the following, which is currently considered the most important aspect in the evaluation of acute abdomen?

options.opa: Realization of a complete anamnesis and meticulous physical exploration.
options.opb: Assessment of the blood count, especially the white blood cell count and formula.
options.opc: Evaluation of the results obtained in abdominal ultrasound.
options.opd: Evaluation of the results obtained in abdominal CT.
